card.essence: Nux vomica is the premier remedy for modern ailments arising from overstimulation, excess, and sedentary mental work. The typical patient is thin, wiry, irritable, and hypersensitive—a perfectionist driven to extremes by business pressures, late hours, rich food, coffee, alcohol, and stimulants. Over-indulgence leads to gastric disturbance, constipation with ineffectual urging, and a state of tense, spasmodic inharmony. Every trifle—noise, odour, draught, contradiction—offends and angers. Easily chilled, cannot bear uncovering.

keynotes.text: Irritable, oversensitive to noise, odours, light; every harmless word offends
Chilly; cannot bear uncovering even during fever; least uncovering brings on chill
Sleepy early evening, wakes 3–4 A.M., cannot sleep again; wakes tired and worse
Frequent ineffectual urging for stool; passes little, sensation as if unfinished
Convulsions with consciousness; worse from touch, emotion, anger
Antidotes effects of coffee, tobacco, alcohol, aromatics, patent medicines, over-drugging
Stomach: pressure as from a stone 1–2 hours after eating; must loosen clothing
Sedentary mental workers with brain-fag, business cares, stimulant use, late hours

modalities_worse.text: Early morning (3–4 A.M. waking, also worse 9 A.M.)
Cold, dry air; open air; draughts; uncovering
Coffee, alcohol, tobacco, stimulants, condiments, rich food, overeating
Mental exertion, worry, sedentary habits, disturbed sleep, late hours
Noise, odours, light, music, touch, slight causes, anger, vexation
Pressure of clothes, especially at waist
After eating; mental work after meals

modalities_better.text: Wrapping head; warm room; hot drinks; milk

mentals: Irritable, impatient, fault-finding, disposed to reproach others; sullen
Zealous, fiery temperament; very particular, careful, perfectionist
Quarrelsome, spiteful, malicious; ugly impulses; impulse to destroy or throw child into fire
Oversensitive; trifling ailments unbearable; time passes too slowly
Anxiety with suicidal thoughts but afraid to die; melancholy hypochondriasis
Brain-fag from business details, mental strain; can't use mind after meals
Gets mad at inanimate objects (kicks chair, tears clothing if it catches)
Nagging, critical; nervous and excitable; fears poverty
physicals: Stomach: pressure as from stone 1–2 hours after eating; must loosen clothing; sleepy after dinner
Nausea constant, worse morning; 'if I could only vomit I'd feel better'
Constipation with frequent ineffectual urging; sensation as if unfinished; small quantities; alternate constipation/diarrhoea
Coryza: fluent by day and in open air, stuffed at night and in warm room
Headache: in occiput or over eyes, vertex (as if nail driven in); worse morning, sunshine, mental exertion, coffee
Backache: as if breaking in lumbar region; must sit up to turn over in bed
Menses: too early, profuse, prolonged, or intermittent; aggravation of all symptoms during menses
Labour pains violent, spasmodic; cause urging to stool or urinate; worse in back
Photophobia much worse in morning; infra-orbital neuralgia
Twitchings, jerks, spasms; lightning-like pains; crawling along spine
Violent cough throwing patient down; paroxysmal, whooping
Eructations sour, bitter; heart-burn; water-brash; violent vomiting bilious-sour
Haemorrhoids itching, better cool bathing; congestive headache associated with piles
Liver sore, sticking, enlarged; gall-stone colic; portal congestion
Offensive breath; taste bitter-sour, bad in morning
Stiff neck; acute lumbago; cramps in calves and soles
Jaundice; sour sweat; takes colds easily
clinical: Digestive disturbances, dyspepsia, gastritis in business men with sedentary habits, stimulant use
Portal congestion, liver complaints, biliousness, jaundice
Constipation in those who've taken purgatives all their lives; alternate constipation/diarrhoea
Catarrh, snuffles of infants; chronic rhinitis from cold dry air
Migraine, headache in sunshine, congestive headache
Neuralgias (infra-orbital, prodromal); optic neuritis from alcohol/tobacco
Brain-fag, insomnia from mental overwork, broken sleep patterns
Dysmenorrhoea with cramps spreading over whole body
One of the best 'antidote' remedies for cases drugged by mixtures, bitters, nostrums—if symptoms correspond
Convulsive disorders with retained consciousness; traumatic tetanus-like states
Effects of debauchery, high living, coffee, alcohol, tobacco
Lumbago; acute back pain requiring patient to sit up to turn in bed

differentials.note: Ignatia more hysteric, contradictory symptoms, sighing; Nux more angry, businesslike, portal congestion. Both contain Strychnine/Brucia
Sulphur acts better in morning; Nux at night. Both have alternate constipation/diarrhoea, aggravation during menses
Bryonia has no desire for stool (inactive); Nux has constant ineffectual urging. Both have gastric complaints
Kali-bi has pressure immediately after eating; Nux 1–2 hours after
Related remedy; both have liver/digestive focus but Lycopodium is less angry, more cowardly
Both oversensitive and irritable; Chamomilla more in children, one cheek red; Nux in sedentary adults
Both have impulses and irritability; Nit-ac more splinter-like pains, fissures
Strychnia (pure alkaloid) has more tetanic spasms, less relaxation between fits; higher temp in true tetanus

cautions: Do not prescribe routinely as 'antidote' to prior drugging without confirming symptom similarity
Give at night during repose of mind and body for best action
Overdrugged patients may need Nux to settle symptoms before reliable case-taking is possible
In acute Strychnia poisoning: convulsions re-excited by slightest touch; distinguish from true tetanus (trismus late, muscles relax between spasms)
